info.title: Collections360GoldenCustomerDataProduct
info.description: Enterprise Golden Collections 360 Customer and Delinquency Data Contract. Defines schema, data quality thresholds, SLA, and permitted operational AI uses.

serviceLevelAgreement.freshness: Hourly batch + CDC streaming (max lag 15 minutes)

qualityRules.description: Required fields (customer_id, name, primary_phone, segment, total_outstanding, dpd) must not be null.
Primary keys and normalized identity hashes must have 0 unresolved duplicates in Golden store.
Phone numbers must match E.164 regex, email format RFC 5322, DPD >= 0, and bureau scores between 300 and 900.
Total outstanding debt in Collections 360 must match the exact sum of associated cards and loans.
Records refreshed within SLA timestamp window (< 24 hours).

permittedUses: Customer contact channel optimization and scheduling
Next Best Action (NBA) agent recommendation with mandatory human review
Portfolio roll-rate delinquency monitoring and analytics
Post-call interaction summarization and compliance audit
Controlled natural language queries and RAG retrieval
prohibitedUses: Adverse credit decisions utilizing protected demographic attributes (gender, religion, ethnicity)
Autonomous execution of legal notices or field dispatch without human approval
Sharing customer PII or financial details outside authenticated RBAC roles
